That is REFUTED: the script's SECOND validator candidate, $CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py, resolves, and the script completed a 328-skill run.

items.gotcha: quick_validate.py:23 calls read_text() with NO encoding, so on Windows it raises UnicodeDecodeError charmap 0x8f on any UTF-8 SKILL.md. validate-all-skills.ps1:9 sets PYTHONUTF8=1, which masks it. Calling the validator directly without that env var produced FALSE failures on bc-drive and bc-drive-plus - a detector artifact, not a defect in those skills.
